title: Report possible change impact
description: Relate a proposed changed-entity selection to potentially affected engineering entities using declared influence scope and traversal results. Explain each possible impact without claiming a proven behavioral consequence.
inputs: Selected model state and identities of entities proposed to change.
Declared relationship types and influence directions, optional exploration limits, and scoped traversal results.
outputs: Potentially affected entities, each with a supporting path from a selected change subject.
Impact scope, limitations, uncovered areas, and explicit interpretation as potential impact.
behavior: Keep the change subject, model state, and relationship scope identifiable.
Use returned reachable entities and supporting typed paths to explain potential impact.
Carry incomplete traversal, missing links, and requested limits into the result.
Distinguish no reachable entity in a complete selected scope from an assertion that the change has no effects.
Leave actual consequence, required action, and evidence applicability judgments to their responsible assessments.

failure_behavior.condition: A proposed changed entity is missing or ambiguous.
failure_behavior.outcome: Report the unresolved subject and do not manufacture a starting impact path.

failure_behavior.condition: Traversal results belong to a different state or scope.
failure_behavior.outcome: Reject those results for this assessment and identify the mismatch.

failure_behavior.condition: Relationship coverage or traversal is incomplete.
failure_behavior.outcome: Present only bounded potential impact with the uncovered scope visible; do not claim full impact coverage.

unallocated_reason: Architectural allocation is deliberately deferred until Module responsibilities are designed; this draft claims no Module ownership or implementation.

sources.basis: IR-002 / SR-011 confirms explainable relationship-based potential impact using SR-009 traversal semantics.
